texts.Home:GettingStartedText: Internship Journal is an ABP Framework application for tracking internship workplaces, intern profiles and daily logs.
texts.Home:WorkplacesText: Manage internship workplaces with nested country, province and district selection.
texts.Home:InternProfilesText: Manage intern profiles, mentors and internship periods.
